author: image-gen bot (assets/generated)
status: proposal; defaults unchanged (README-SP / repo config.rs Springs / physics-lab/physics.toml)
compatible_with: repo crates/lillith-core/src/spring.rs (Channel: root_x, root_y, angle, scale, chest, pigtail)
integrator: semi-implicit Euler, fixed 120 Hz sub-steps, velocity + offset clamps

tasteful_changes._label: OPTIONAL, all labelled TASTEFUL_CHANGE; none applied to the defaults above. Purpose: keep motion elegant and subtle on a clothed, modest companion.

chest_visual_cap.label: TASTEFUL_CHANGE
chest_visual_cap.proposal: renderer caps the VISIBLE chest effect at about 1.5% vertical squash/stretch (about 3 px on a 400 px sprite) even when the spring offset reaches its 12 px clamp
chest_visual_cap.why: the chest channel is applied to the whole sprite until layered art exists; a 12 px offset would read as the whole body bouncing. Spring numbers stay 65/9.5.

chest_from_pigtails.label: TASTEFUL_CHANGE
chest_from_pigtails.proposal: keep physics.toml chest.sympathetic_from_pigtails at 0.15 or lower; do not raise chest_bounce above 1.0
chest_from_pigtails.why: secondary echo only; chest motion should follow the body, never lead it

pigtail_lag.label: TASTEFUL_CHANGE
pigtail_lag.proposal: keep a 0.05 s hair lag (physics.toml pigtails.lag_s) and alternate the kick sign per footfall
pigtail_lag.why: reads as hair weight rather than wobble

drag_hold.label: TASTEFUL_CHANGE
drag_hold.proposal: while drag_held plays, set the angle target from cursor velocity (clamped to 0.12 rad) and let pigtails/tail trail; on drop, use physics.toml impulse_recipes.drag at 0.8x
drag_hold.why: dangling sway with a soft landing instead of a big rebound

attachments._note: Canvas px on the shared 400x400 canvas (x right, y down, baseline 392, anchor [200,392]); 'normalised' = px/400 from the frame's top-left (physics.toml [attachments] convention). Clip-level value = median over frames; per-frame values are in each clip JSON under frame_points[name][frame] (the importer ignores that key; clip-level *_point fields become Clip.points). pigtail_left/right = screen-left/right. Left clips are mirrors (x' = 399 - x, labels swapped).

channel_map.hip_point: root_x / angle pivot for hip sway (no dedicated hip spring)

drivers._note: Summary only; numbers live in physics-lab/physics.toml
drivers.idle: breath oscillator (3.5-4.5 s) -> chest 1.2 px and scale 0.006; pigtail micro-sway 1.5 px / 2.8 s; tail figure-8 overlay
drivers.walk: 2 footfalls per cycle: root_y 10, chest 22, pigtails 18 (sign alternates); angle kick 0.25 on start, chest 20 on stop
drivers.drag: impulse_recipes.drag on pick-up and drop; pigtails/tail trail cursor velocity

removed.idle: v6: breathing lift, 2% chest widen, pigtail bounce, hip sway, shoulder tilt removed (old: idle/_v5_baked_jiggle/)
removed.wave: v3: breathing lift and pigtail sway removed (old: wave/_v2_baked_jiggle/)

baked_motion_audit.kept_tail_only: idle, wave, knife_tap keep a small tail-curl sway (about 3 px), because no engine channel moves tail pixels yet; drop it once the tail overlay/cutout exists
baked_motion_audit.choreography_clips: hip_sway, lean_forward, shoulder_roll, tail_wag, dance and nod bake their own motion on purpose; physics.toml also models hip_sway/lean_forward/shoulder_roll as idle_transitions spring sequences, so the engine should use ONE of the two for each (suggest: the spring sequence on the idle clip, or the clip with that clip's recipe = none)

flirty.label: TASTEFUL_CHANGE
flirty.summary: Playful/flirty mood for the allure clips: slightly lower chest and pigtail damping so the settle has one more soft rebound; stiffness, gains and clamps unchanged. Still subtle and companion-appropriate.

limits.chest_visual_cap: keep the ~1.5% visible squash cap from tasteful_changes.chest_visual_cap

flirty.enter: blend over ~0.4 s when an allure clip starts or the Playful/Mischievous mood is active; return to defaults over ~1 s after
flirty.impulses: each allure clip JSON has impulse_frames [{frame, channel (chest/pigtails/root_y/angle/hip), strength 0-1, optional sign}]; hip = root_x + angle about hip_point. Suggested full-strength impulses at 1.0: chest 45, pigtails 70, root_y 30, angle 1.0, hip (root_x 50 + angle 0.6), i.e. physics.toml run/stab scale
flirty.relation_to_physics_toml: physics.toml [moods.Playful] already lowers chest zeta to ~0.50; this preset is slightly gentler (0.53) and is meant to be merged there by the physics bot
